## 定级(skills 车道自分诊):`Task` · `priority:p2` · `pm:queue` · `domain:skills`

复发 9 例是对 2026-08-28 裁定的持续违反,成本为复审席每轮空耗一趟 + 标签机读语义腐蚀 ⇒ 高于 p3;无错误合并、无正确性伤害 ⇒ 非 p1。**升 p1 条件**:一次预挂导致真实待审载体被跳过或误处置。

采卡的根因方向:修法落在**定级/认领流程文本的条款②段** —— 把「判定(裁决时点名条款②预期)」与「挂载(增量存在时,由开 PR 的同笔挂)」两个动作在文本上分开,并引 2026-08-28 裁定原文;`references/contract-review.md` 的「⛔ 不预挂」段为单源,只加指针不复制细则。

**入队不即派(面持)**:候选落点 SKILL.md 认领模板段(被候批 PR #13505 持有)与 dispatch-runbook.md(被在飞 #13304 持有)⇒ 排两者之后;届时与同面卡按五门判折叠。

Hypothesis **VERIFIED** — this card survives the value gate and stays queued: it is a correction of text that contradicts a standing ruling, not an addition.

Measured on origin/main `9c120f030`: `SKILL.md:758` reads 「派发席职责止于:卡上记一行认定、挂 `needs:contract-review`(标签命名审的对象,恒英文)、…」 — the dispatch seat's clause-② duty as written INSTRUCTS same-stroke hanging, exactly what the 2026-08-28 ruling abolished. `references/contract-review.md:43` pulls the same direction (「条款②的 `mode:subagent` 派发照旧恒保留 `needs:contract-review`」) against that file's own :10 ⛔不预挂. The 9 measured recurrences trace to live text, not to seats ignoring text.

Scope when dispatched: in-place correction of SKILL.md:758 (判定记卡;挂载随可复审增量,由 PR 创建者同笔) plus reconciliation of contract-review.md:43 with its own :10 — word-level, net ≤0 lines. Serial: SKILL.md is held by PR #13505's chain; this card is next on that face after it clears. Explicitly NOT frozen into audit #13597 — ruling-contradiction corrections keep flowing; the freeze is for additions.

Verified: a 2-line, net-0 in-place rewrite of SKILL.md :758–759 — the duty list no longer instructs a hang at the grading stroke; `needs:contract-review` is attached **by the PR creator** in the same stroke as the reviewable increment, with the 恒英文 naming note riding the hang sentence and every surviving duty intact. The diff context confirms what the flight surfaced: the old text was SELF-contradictory (the duty list said hang-now while the very next clause said only-when-increment) — which explains the 9 measured misfires better than a simple omission would. All four `needs:contract-review` occurrences adjudicated (147/589/897 kept with reasons, 758 rewritten; the 889→897 position correction is honest re-measurement). contract-review.md:43 adjudicated as requirement-retention on structural evidence (section subject = 降档保险丝; contrast target = 免审跳过; timing owned by :7–11) and correctly left untouched, with the optional sharpening deferred to audit #13597 Phase 3 — the minimal-diff call the audit era wants. Acceptance table live at both refs (9 anchors, positive controls non-zero); both edited lines ≤120 bytes; ratchet lines quoted green (960/1005 · 48/48); 9 derived families + nul-bytes green; governed posture held.

Noted for the record: the 2026-08-28 ruling's carrier issue #12887 is measured UNREACHABLE (404 on issue page and REST — appears deleted). The ruling's single source in `contract-review.md:10` carries it; the deleted-carrier fact goes to the audit's inputs.

Landing is the maintainer's: draft stays, hotlong requested. On merge this card closes and `pm:dispatched` gets stripped in the same sweep.
